## Summary
Track the first end-to-end Bilqis research program from semantic substrate definition through **lexical/grammar bootstrapping, local M3 Ultra qualification**, dataset generation, developmental teaching, oracle validation, student training, sealed evaluation, attribution controls, recovery, robustness, external baselines, ontology-growth stress tests, replication, claim calibration, later natural-language education and reproducible release.

This roadmap is deliberately stricter than a normal ML TODO list. The scientific claim is not merely that a model can learn a synthetic task. The program must determine whether an explicit Bilqis-derived semantic substrate changes the resource cost of acquiring reusable relational/compositional competence under matched information and controlled training conditions, and where explicit structure becomes harmful, brittle, expensive, ontologically closed or architecture-specific.

## Program invariants

- **Cognition precedes language:** the first learner must master a bounded formal logic + necessary mathematics + Rosetta epistemic substrate before New Ithkuil semantic exposure, except for narrowly admitted Ithkuil-derived factors required to express a missing Rosetta primitive.
- **Rosetta semantics precede Rosetta serialization:** Bilqis learns Observation/Conjecture/Evaluation/Episteme/provenance/etc. as semantic compositions; deterministic code emits conformant Rosetta artifacts. Tile JSON is not a cognitive primitive.
- **Grammar precedes broad lexicon:** after the pre-language gate, New Ithkuil semantic grammar is taught before broad root expansion; the 6000+ root lexicon then grows an already structured semantic space.
- Grammar and semantic machinery are mapped before broad lexical expansion.
- The developmental bootstrap path is explicit: **formal cognitive algebra -> necessary mathematics -> Rosetta epistemic algebra -> New Ithkuil semantic grammar -> New Ithkuil lexicon -> natural language** (#80/#85/#83/#84/#86/#82/#53/#37).
- The source-preparation pipeline MAY map New Ithkuil and its lexicon ahead of learner exposure; developmental order constrains what the student is taught, not when humans/tools are allowed to prepare later curriculum artifacts.
- The Top-K lexical seed is semantic rebar, not the ontology.
- Pretrained/LLM teachers may propose mappings and curriculum; they do not become truth authority.
- **Scratch-trained means no inherited task-capable neural weights, not IID semantic amnesia. The integrated Bilqis treatment uses deterministic semantic initialization from #62; random/permuted initialization remains attribution/control work.**
- Lexical semantics, contingent world knowledge and mere association remain distinguishable.
- The shared latent world is authoritative; renderers/codecs do not define truth.
- `LLM proposes; formal machinery disposes`: the teacher may shape curriculum but may not supply gold answers or certify mastery.
- Formal supervision must survive explicit corruption/taint-recovery drills; deterministic consistency is not treated as proof of semantic correctness.
- Treatment/control examples derive from the same semantic worlds wherever the comparison requires information parity.
- Ambiguity may be represented as multiple live interpretations; explicitness must not silently force premature commitment.
- `UNKNOWN_VALUE` and `UNKNOWN_VARIABLE` are different scientific problems: later work must test whether the semantic schema itself can be incomplete and extended rather than assuming every useful distinction was present in the initial ontology.
- The initial prerequisite graph is a frozen developmental hypothesis, not an unquestioned cognitive DAG; later topology discovery is empirical and versioned.
- Primitive metacognitive revision belongs in development once representable: prediction -> evidence -> discrepancy -> error class -> bounded correction -> retest (#56). This does not imply a full agentic Rationality Kernel.
- Cleaner/more explicit training is not assumed universally superior: controlled reconstruction pressure may be useless tax, useful regularization, or regime-dependent and must be tested rather than narrated.
- TRAIN/DEV/SEALED boundaries are enforced before efficacy results are visible.
- Failed seeds, interrupted runs, invalidations, reversals and deviations remain in the lineage.
- Positive-result escalation and null/reversal autopsy rules are both preregistered and non-overlapping.
- **Large runs are confirmations, not first discovery:** the M3 Ultra local ladder (#52) must remove engineering uncertainty and search for early learning-curve separation before materially larger compute is justified.
- Representation effect, semantic-initialization effect, curriculum effect, precision effect, architecture interaction, ontology-extension cost and compiler/infrastructure cost are measured separately.
- Internally matched generic controls and external established semantic frameworks answer different questions and must not be conflated.
- System-effect experiments precede expensive attribution, with quantitative escalation gates.
- Representation and initialization geometry are measured before efficacy unblinding so later mechanism claims are not invented from outcome-driven diagnostics.
- Natural-language acquisition is allowed to add competence but not silently erase earlier semantic distinctions; later transfer consumes the semantic-conservation gates in #54.
- Post-kernel world knowledge is acquired through a staged educational program (#55), not by immediately replacing semantic development with indiscriminate web-text pretraining.
- **Research horizons are harvested early but remain non-executable until evidence earns them.** Capturing a downstream hypothesis in an issue is not authorization to implement it, spend compute on it, or put it on the critical path.
- **Residualization is downstream of learning, not a synonym for it.** Lossless factoring may reduce later interpretation cost only if raw evidence, novelty, exceptions, and end-to-end accounting remain intact (#66).
- **Exact identity and sparse semantic resolution remain distinct.** A small cue set may contract a candidate space toward known structure, but ambiguity, abstention, false resolution, and retrieval/index cost must remain measurable (#67).
- Hypothesis, operational construct, planned control, implemented control, observed system effect, mechanism, transfer, scaling and economic projection remain distinguishable through versioned claim/evidence and control-lifecycle manifests.

## Execution map

### A. Scientific controls and governance
- #1 Semantic Coverage Gate
- #2 Adversarial sibling-branch generation
- #3 Quantitative compute-escalation gates for positive signals
- #4 Compiler-capital amortization ledger and break-even sensitivity surface
- #43 Claim/evidence calibration, control lifecycle and rhetorical-drift audit
- #47 Predeclared null/reversal autopsy paths

### B. Foundation and semantic substrate
- #6 Repository structure, reproducibility and experiment lineage
- #7 Semantic ABI and canonical AST, including multiple live interpretations
- #8 New Ithkuil grammar -> machine-usable semantic-factor map
- #9 Supplemental cognitive algebra
  - **#79 COGAL-01** Rationality/source corpus -> developmental tranches
  - **#80 COGAL-02** pre-language formal logic kernel
  - **#85 COGAL-07** minimal mathematical relational substrate
  - **#83 COGAL-05** Rosetta primitive genealogy / Bilqis curriculum crosswalk
  - **#84 COGAL-06** pre-language Rosetta epistemic algebra + serialization boundary
  - **#86 COGAL-08** frozen pre-language semantic/token/geometry manifest
  - **#82 COGAL-04** logic -> maths -> Rosetta -> New Ithkuil developmental curriculum
- **#53 Lexical-seed -> grammar traversal -> lexicon/typed-graph expansion loop**
- #10 Deterministic compiler and representation codecs
- #11 Token ABI and tokenizer policy
- **#62 Deterministic semantic initialization from the semantic ABI**
- #35 Source/licensing/redistribution policy

### C. Dataset, worlds, truth authority and integrity
- #12 Deterministic finite-world generators and generator families
- #13 Independent truth oracle and query semantics, including common-mode specification-failure controls
- #14 TRAIN/DEV/SEALED/generator-family split policy
- #15 Task families, competence thresholds, retention and transfer endpoints
- #38 Dataset integrity auditor for leakage/collisions/shortcuts/imbalance
- #42 Pre-training representation access-geometry audit
- #46 Semantic supervision corruption and lineage-taint stress test

### D. Developmental teacher and curriculum
- #16 Truth-bounded developmental teacher
- #17 Frozen prerequisite graph and developmental stage contracts
- **#56 Primitive metacognitive error-state/revision curriculum**
- #1 Semantic Coverage Gate integrated into promotion
- #2 Adversarial sibling generation integrated into batch admission
- #45 Empirical prerequisite-topology discovery from learning-cost interventions
- **#65 Kev-4B + SemIf/MLX decision-native engine qualification for bounded mapping/curriculum choices; Kev-4B is the first trained engine, SemIf the baseline/comparator; never truth authority**

### E. Student, local qualification and training machinery
- #18 Fixed small baseline student and semantic decoder
- #20 Checkpointing, crash recovery and resumable lineage
- #21 Unified resource accounting
- **#64 Apple-Silicon accelerated training backend with CPU parity witness**
- **#52 M3 Ultra machine qualification -> accelerated end-to-end micro-run -> local learning-curve pilot -> replicated pilot -> next-rung receipt**
- #19 Ternary-forward training semantics for the intended Bilqis learner path; dense/BF16 remains the reference witness/control rather than a prerequisite product architecture

### F. First confirmatory systems trial
- **#63 Correct scratch-training/SYS-01 contract before plan lock: semantic initialization is treatment; random initialization is control**
- #22 SYS-01 preregistration and plan lock, including operational semantic-reconstruction-tax definition, explicit initialization profiles, explicit non-claims, endpoint hierarchy, multiplicity/stopping policy and #47 autopsy rules
- #23 G0 engineering qualification gate, including #46 taint drill and the applicable #52 local-readiness evidence
- #24 SYS-01 paired-seed execution
- #25 Paired/statistical analysis and failure-inclusive reporting

### G. Attribution, hostile controls and robustness
- #26 Matched-example replay for adaptive-curriculum separation
- #27 Generic typed-IR control
- #28 Token-renaming, factor-isomorphic permutation and nonseparable factor-mixing controls
- #29 Compute-matched frontier / sequence-economics control
- #30 Developmental-order ablations
- #31 Unseen-generator, unseen-composition, cross-codec and cross-domain analogical transfer
- #33 Post-signal latent diagnostics and causal interventions
- #44 Ambiguity preservation and delayed semantic commitment benchmark
- #45 Empirical prerequisite-topology discovery
- #48 Established semantic-representation baselines on faithful task intersections
- #50 Open-world ontology extension and schema-novelty adaptation
- #51 Controlled reconstruction-pressure / abstraction-robustness intervention

### H. Gated extensions, replication and release
- #32 Model-scale replication, only after escalation gates
- #49 Cross-architecture representation interaction, only after signal/attribution gates
- #34 Cold-operator replication
- #43 Final claim/evidence and control-lifecycle audit
- #36 First public reproducible research release

### I. Post-kernel language and education program
- #37 Later natural-language codec transfer with pragmatic stress testing and full parser/core/generator interface economics
- **#54 Semantic-conservation / catastrophic-forgetting gates during language acquisition**
- **#55 Staged post-kernel educational curriculum and world-knowledge acquisition**

### J. Preserved downstream research horizons — blocked until earned
These issues are durable hypothesis/architecture harvests, **not implementation backlog ready for execution**. Their job is to prevent chat-log archaeology and semantic rediscovery while keeping immature architecture off the near-term critical path.

- **#57 Semantically typed modular learned functions** — test KAN/spline/other bounded learned functions only after Bilqis evidence motivates typed local computation; preserve parametric/structural/representational/activation plasticity as distinct research surfaces.
- **#59 Recursive semantic model lineage and adjacent-resolution interoperability** — test shared semantic identity across model tiers while preserving the invariant `same reference identity != same comprehension`; require explicit capability/projection-loss contracts.
- **#58 Bilqis -> OMoC bridge** — consume existing Rosetta OMoC ownership and test whether semantically addressable cognitive resources/routes can be composed without duplicating public or protected routing architecture.
- **#66 Residualized ingress / marginal interpretation cost** — test whether already-known structural and semantic regularity can be losslessly factored so expensive cognition scales with unresolved residual rather than raw input volume.
- **#67 Sparse semantic addressing** — test whether a few highly discriminative cues can contract candidate spaces enough to recover richer known semantic objects/neighborhoods without conflating probabilistic resolution with exact content identity.

A horizon issue transitions toward executable decomposition only when its own evidence-to-unblock conditions are satisfied and recorded. Otherwise it remains useful documentation, not implied roadmap commitment.

## Intended order of operations
1. #6, #35
2. #7 plus **#79/#80**: establish the semantic ABI and formal logic kernel.
3. **#85 -> #83 -> #84**: admit only the mathematics needed for relational cognition, mine Rosetta's primitive genealogy, then define the pre-language Rosetta epistemic algebra.
4. #8/#53 MAY prepare New Ithkuil grammar and lexical mappings in parallel, but learner exposure remains blocked until the pre-language gate.
5. #10, #11, #62 plus **#86**: freeze the complete pre-language semantic/token/geometry substrate before learner training.
6. #12, #13
7. #14, #15, #38, #42
8. #16, #17 plus **#82** and #1/#2 integration: freeze developmental order and promotion gates as logic -> maths -> Rosetta -> New Ithkuil grammar -> lexicon -> later natural language; implement only the #56 primitives needed by the admitted stages.
9. #18, #19, #20, #21 and enough #46 machinery for the required G0 taint drill; dense/reference and ternary-forward paths share the same semantic curriculum contract, with ternary as the intended learner path.
10. **#64**: qualify an Apple-GPU training path against the CPU reference; then #52 qualifies the actual M3 Ultra and runs the staged curriculum micro-run / smallest frozen learning-curve pilot. #65/Kev-4B may accelerate bounded source-grounded grammar/semantic mapping but never supplies learner truth authority.
11. Complete #47 and #63; then freeze #22 using local feasibility evidence without promoting exploratory local effects into confirmatory claims; initialize #43 claim/control/source-version registries from the frozen preregistration.
12. #23, including the #46 end-to-end taint propagation and rollback exercise plus verification that the exact SYS-01 configuration is executable under its declared compute environment.
13. #24
14. #25
15. Classify the result under #3 positive escalation and/or the already-frozen #47 null/reversal autopsy rules.
16. Execute only attribution/robustness work authorized by that outcome, starting with the cheapest discriminating controls. Candidate branches include selected #26-#31, #33, #44, #45, #48, #50 and #51, using #42 geometry without treating descriptive diagnostics as causal proof.
17. If further earned: #32 and/or #49. Each larger rung must preserve #52/#3's compute-ratchet principle rather than jumping directly to a headline-scale run.
18. #34
19. Finalize #43 against the actual execution/analysis/control lifecycle state.
20. #36
21. **#37 + #54** as the next interface/transfer program rather than evidence retroactively imported into SYS-01.
22. **#55** only after a semantic core and language/interface path have sufficient demonstrated integrity to support staged real-world education.
23. **#57/#59/#58/#66/#67 remain horizon nodes throughout the above sequence.** When and only when their evidence gates become true, re-run issue decomposition and create the smallest executable child experiment rather than activating the horizon wholesale.

## Gating logic
- SYS-01 MUST NOT execute before #23 passes against the exact #22 plan lock.
- #52 local qualification/pilot evidence informs feasibility and the next smallest compute rung but cannot retroactively define SYS-01 success criteria from favorable exploratory noise.
- #47 MUST be complete before #22 freezes the SYS-01 null/reversal autopsy rules.
- #22 MUST bind the frozen #42 representation-and-initialization-geometry manifest, #62 initializer profile/tensor identities, #17 stage/prerequisite version and #47 null/reversal autopsy plan before confirmatory efficacy results are inspected.
- #23 MUST include the #46 semantic-taint detection/lineage/rollback drill.
- Any SEALED exposure, oracle defect, codec information mismatch, unreconciled lineage failure or semantic-taint event creates a new analysis epoch or invalidates the affected run under the preregistered policy.
- Expensive attribution/scale/architecture work MUST follow #3 or an explicitly authorized bounded path from #47 rather than enthusiasm.
- A positive SYS-01 result is a system effect until controls distinguish representation, semantic initialization, teacher/curriculum, sequence economics, tokenizer effects, generic factorization and other candidate mechanisms.
- IID random initialization is an attribution/control condition, not the definition of scratch training.
- If a #65-qualified decision engine participates in confirmatory teacher decisions, its exact engine/model/runtime/prompt identity, privileges, fallback and call budget MUST be frozen by #22.
- A null or reversal is substantive evidence within the tested regime; #47 constrains any permitted autopsy rather than assuming the project must be rescued.
- #44 may demonstrate that preserving structured ambiguity is superior to forced explicit commitment; such a result narrows rather than contradicts the broader representation-first program.
- #45 may revise or reverse authored prerequisite edges only for a future graph version, never retroactively inside SYS-01.
- #50 may introduce a new ABI/schema version only in a later experimental epoch; it MUST NOT keep the SYS-01 semantic ABI unfrozen or retroactively add missing factors to earlier results.
- #51 manipulates benign/recoverable representational nuisance while holding intended oracle truth fixed; incorrect semantics and label corruption belong to #46 instead.
- #27 and #48 answer different questions: tight internal information matching versus external-framework credibility.
- #49 cannot be used to generalize across architectures until its gate is earned and executed.
- #37 must count the full natural-language interface path, including pragmatic codec failures and parser/generator resources, before making end-to-end efficiency claims.
- #54 can fail a language-transfer regime even when language metrics improve if critical semantic distinctions regress beyond the frozen conservation threshold.
- #55 MUST report reasoning competence, factual acquisition, language competence and retained semantic integrity separately.
- **#57, #59, #58, #66 and #67 are `BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY` research horizons. Presence in this roadmap does not satisfy their gates or authorize implementation.** Any transition toward implementation requires a new workability/decomposition pass bound to the triggering evidence.
- #66 must not report compression ratio, fewer model calls, or shorter context as interpretation-efficiency evidence unless total cost falls at matched correctness, novelty sensitivity, and exception recall.
- #67 must preserve `exact identity != semantic resolution`; absent/ambiguous cases must be able to abstain rather than being forced onto known semantic nodes.
- #57 must not become a blanket KAN-replacement program; its first earned experiment is a bounded typed-function comparison.
- #59 must not infer equal comprehension from shared reference identity or silently truncate unsupported semantic structure across model tiers.
- #58 must consume existing Rosetta OMoC contracts and public/protected boundaries rather than re-specifying routing inside Bilqis.
- #36 MUST NOT publish a final research release until #43 confirms that headline claims and control-status statements remain inside the evidence actually produced by the corresponding result epoch.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Every first-run work item is represented by an issue with a falsifiable completion condition.
- [ ] Dependencies and plan-lock boundaries are explicit.
- [ ] The original lexical-seed -> grammar -> lexicon bootstrap is represented explicitly rather than flattened into `map grammar`.
- [ ] The actual M3 Ultra is the first qualified training environment and every larger compute rung has an evidence-backed reason to exist.
- [ ] SYS-01 cannot begin until G0 engineering/integrity and taint-recovery gates pass.
- [ ] Representation and initialization-geometry differences are measured before efficacy unblinding.
- [ ] The integrated Bilqis treatment can begin with deterministic semantic initialization while retaining random and permuted initialization as later attribution controls.
- [ ] The actual M3 Ultra training path uses #64 acceleration evidence rather than assuming CPU execution represents the hardware.
- [ ] Null/reversal follow-up freedom is bounded before results are known.
- [ ] Ambiguity preservation, prerequisite topology, primitive revision/metacognition and coherent semantic-fault propagation have explicit experimental surfaces.
- [ ] Ontology incompleteness/schema growth and the `tax versus useful reconstruction pressure` alternative have explicit post-SYS experimental surfaces.
- [ ] Attribution/scaling/architecture work cannot silently begin because an outcome is exciting or disappointing.
- [ ] Later natural-language transfer includes pragmatic stress cases, semantic-conservation gates and full interface-resource accounting rather than core-only economics.
- [ ] Later education is staged by semantic/compositional complexity and dependency rather than `random scads of text`.
- [ ] Downstream KAN/local-function, recursive-model-lineage, OMoC integration, residualized-ingress, and sparse-semantic-addressing hypotheses have durable issue homes with explicit maturity/gating state instead of relying on chat history.
- [ ] Research-horizon issues cannot enter execution merely because they are linked from the roadmap.
- [ ] The final run can be reconstructed from immutable inputs, configs, seeds, checkpoints, code revision and result artifacts.
- [ ] Claim state, control lifecycle and evidence scope are auditable before public release.
- [ ] A simpler representation, established external framework, alternate architecture, learned-latent strategy or direct-NL system is allowed to match or beat Bilqis without being treated as a failed research program.

This issue is the coordination spine; individual scientific and engineering claims live in child issues.

comments.body: Parallel batch added: #68 coordinates decision-native semantic navigation over the Bilqis substrate, with #69 fixture/control corpus, #70 deterministic semantic-neighborhood compiler, #71 SemIf door-walk/repair handshake, #72 representation × decision-mechanism benchmark, and #73 optional Akasha/FalkorDB utility slice. This work is designed to run in parallel with #62/#63/#64 and does not replace SYS-01.

Roadmap delta from #78 + current training-design discussion:

The near-term foundation should now treat **pre-language cognitive algebra as a first-class developmental gate**, not merely a supplemental side corpus.

New #9 decomposition:
- #79 source/tranche map
- #80 T0-T4 logic-kernel pasigraph + evaluators
- #81 token geometry / ternary-compatible semantic initialization contract
- #82 logic-first curriculum + language-admission gate

Recommended ordering adjustment inside the existing foundation path:

`#7 + #79/#80 -> #8/#53 bounded grammar/lexical bootstrap -> #10/#11 -> #81/#62 -> #17/#82 -> #18/#19/#64/#52`

The intent is not “finish all mathematics before language.” The admission gate is bounded: identity, propositional truth functions (including XOR/XNOR), predicate/quantified relations, proof state/tableaux, and explicit FALSE/UNKNOWN/CONFLICT/ambiguity semantics. T6-T10 rationality/metacognitive/social/process tranches can continue later/interleaved.

#78 is evidence that Kev-4B is useful as a bounded source-grounded mapping accelerator for this bootstrap; it remains proposal-only, never semantic truth authority.

A new parallel research family is captured in #87-#98 for the multimodal edge / knowledge-package architecture. It does not redirect SYS-01 or the primary ternary training path. Treat it as a research horizon that may consume successful Bilqis artifacts later. #88-#90 cover EG2 and multimodal semantic projection; #91-#98 cover edge runtime, package exchange, tier roles, update separation, resource economics and the late custom-embedder hypothesis.

#99 preserves the late **companion-projection** branch from the October 2026 architecture discussion.

Only pursue it if #88/#90/#91/#97 show that a multimodal embedding companion is materially valuable and reasonable EG2 adaptation still leaves important gaps. The later question is whether a purpose-built companion sharing Bilqis's semantic constitution improves cross-modal projection, Ithkuil/Rosetta/pasigraph alignment, compact edge use, or semantic conservation enough to justify another model.

It remains separate from Baby Sheba cognition and is not a prerequisite for the primary ternary program.

(#98 was closed as a duplicate after #99 was created with the cleaner durable title.)

### 2026-10-11 roadmap addendum: distinct fast-alpha lane (append-only)

Created **[#102 ALPHA-01](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/issues/102)** for the earliest *actually trained* logic-first Bilqis demo and **[#103 ALPHA-02](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/issues/103)** for replayable, honest presentation of model predictions, perturbations, hard negatives, held-out composition, and failures.

**Sequence:** existing `bilqis_ref` -> tiny frozen fixture-local semantic slice / oracle / codec / token identity -> scratch-trained semantic-initialized learner with intended ternary-forward profile (dense/CPU engineering fallback documented) -> small named regression and holdout checks -> actual checkpoint + manifest (#102) -> replayable showcase (#103). #69/#70's existing fixture/compiler work may be reused, not made a precondition. #65/#71's pretrained decision-native scorer is **not** the Bilqis learner.

**Scope rule:** this is a *non-confirmatory exploratory alpha*, allowed to freeze a small provisional micro-substrate without pretending to have completed all of #79-#86. The full #86 substrate freeze, #52 local readiness, #22 preregistration, #23 G0, and #24/#25 SYS-01 remain authoritative for the confirmatory research epoch. Alpha cannot silently substitute for any of those gates or establish an attributable semantic-reconstruction advantage.

**Why:** the public [ts-rust recovery analysis](https://github.com/pingdotgg/ts-rust/blob/main/docs/typechecker-reset-plan.md) supports literal semantic mapping, early end-to-end parity and **protected prior passes**, not an untested claim that Go/Rust representation alone caused the outcome. Use that as engineering guidance: get the smallest complete thing working, inspect wrong states, iterate quickly, then widen rigor as earned.

No existing issue body or criterion is superseded by this comment.

### 2026-10-11 execution checkpoint and source/intent reconciliation (append-only)

**[Bilqis ALPHA-01 → ALPHA-02 | Codex Execution Checkpoint](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1JIiyP2-4bJVWWHqYYt3TJmmY5FYwc2h-8n41TzIgydY/edit)** is a concise, optional execution handoff for existing owner issues [#102](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/issues/102) then [#103](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/issues/103), placed alongside the original roadmap. It is **not a new architecture, curriculum, ontology, authority or third issue**. [Roadmap supplement](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1x1jtvd1KCfcu7nkz3sLgbaPCBBTEd8NvDeZFaBR-67I/edit) remains the detailed alpha-exit/handoff plan.

**Source audit:** existing `bilqis_ref`/CP0008 finite worlds, small training harness, `abi/token-abi.json`, and reverse-serialization transfer probes are **engineering witnesses**, not the already populated #7/#80/#81/#62 semantic-space compiler/initialization. [#102 source-audit receipt](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/issues/102#issuecomment-6107272176) specifies the actual starting gap. The older #5/#7/#9/#80/#81/#82/#86/#62 contracts and Oct 6 roadmap **already define the intended semantic foundation**; do not substitute the toy reference because it happens to run.

**Only alpha-specific sequencing choice:** execute a tiny, versioned, source-grounded T0/T1 plus narrow T2/T4 experimental projection, then **one bounded real scratch-trained learner attempt** and a replayable microscope, *before* completing the full pre-language freeze. The shortcut is explicitly exploratory and never satisfies or weakens #86, #52 or #22–#25. Confirmatory and comprehensive semantic authorities remain unchanged.

This checkpoint is prepared, not executed. Do not mistake its existence for trained checkpoints or acceptance evidence.

issues.body:
## Summary
Specify the machine-facing semantic ABI that all generators, codecs, teachers, oracles, and students share.

Bilqis should not begin as a bag of surface tokens. The first stable contract is a typed semantic AST with explicit null/default states, scope, composition, evidence, modality, relation structure, provenance, and unresolved-interpretation state sufficient to render multiple representations from the same latent world.

## Initial semantic families
Include at least:
- entities, roles, relations, events and states
- quantity, identity and set membership
- polarity, modality and scope
- temporal ordering and intervals
- evidence/source status: observed, reported, inferred, unknown, conflict
- causal vs correlational structure
- counterfactual/intervention structure
- compositional grouping and configuration
- reference/coreference and ambiguity
- **underspecified semantic state with multiple live admissible interpretations**
- purpose/function/intent where explicitly represented by the world
- confidence/uncertainty where the oracle semantics justify it
- algebraic/logical operators used by the first cognitive-algebra curriculum

## Design rules
- No field may silently overload distinct semantic types.
- Unknown, absent, default, conflict, inapplicable, false, and `multiple live interpretations` must remain distinguishable where required.
- Ambiguity MUST NOT be compiled to a single guessed interpretation merely because the surface codec prefers one linear serialization.
- Where the world/query contract permits multiple interpretations, the ABI must be able to retain the candidate alternatives and their shared/differing structure until evidence resolves them or terminal ambiguity is declared.
- Probabilities over alternatives may be represented only where the task semantics justify them; otherwise preserve an unweighted admissible set rather than inventing confidence.
- Canonical serialization must be deterministic and versioned.
- Surface representations must round-trip through this ABI within their declared retention contracts.
- Schema evolution must not reinterpret historical examples silently.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Versioned machine-readable AST/schema exists.
- [ ] Canonical serialization and hash identity are defined.
- [ ] Positive/negative fixtures cover every initial semantic family.
- [ ] Fixtures distinguish UNKNOWN from a known finite set of multiple admissible interpretations.
- [ ] At least one fixture preserves ambiguity across an evidence update and later resolves it without losing the original alternatives.
- [ ] Round-trip property tests exist for supported codecs.
- [ ] Explicit migration/versioning policy exists for ABI changes.
- [ ] Oracle and coverage signatures consume this ABI rather than renderer text.
- [ ] The ABI can support the delayed-commitment benchmark in #44 without an ad hoc side channel.

## Dependencies
Parent roadmap: #5.
Repository/reproducibility bootstrap: #6.
Ambiguity stress test consumer: #44.

comments.body:
### Alpha-first semantic ABI guidance (2026-10-11; linked to #102)

For the exploratory #102 path, freeze a **small, fixture-local ABI projection** instead of delaying first learning until every semantic family is specified. It is subordinate to this issue: no new Rosetta Core authority, no semantic identity derived from token spelling/number, and no claim that partial implementation satisfies #7.

Borrow the useful failure lesson from [ts-rust's checker reset](https://github.com/pingdotgg/ts-rust/blob/main/docs/typechecker-reset-plan.md): distinguish **resolved value**, **incomplete/deferred work**, **unsupported construct**, **unknown truth**, **conflicting evidence**, **multiple admissible readings**, and **missing/omitted field** at the correct boundary. Those are different categories; one cannot be used as a convenient substitute for another. If an implementation introduces cached or partial semantic state, its lifecycle must be explicit; an incomplete result must never appear at a caller boundary typed as complete merely to make the happy-path fixture pass.

Alpha deliverable: stable semantic identities, a tiny canonical AST schema with declared supported/unsupported variants, positive and hard-negative state-transition fixtures, and exact version/hash. Save broader ABI design here for the full research epoch. Once the alpha exposes a genuine missing distinction, bring evidence back before promoting a new public semantic primitive.

issues.body:
## Summary
Define the non-Ithkuil formal primitives needed for the first developmental curriculum so Bilqis does not force general reasoning into categories the donor language was never designed to carry.

## Initial domains
- identity, equality and inequality
- Boolean/propositional operators
- quantification and set relations
- arithmetic and order relations
- functions and composition
- probability and conditional probability
- evidence accumulation and belief revision
- causal graphs, interventions and counterfactuals
- proof/derivation relations
- consistency, contradiction, unknown and conflict

## Design requirements
- Keep formal primitives distinct from surface words.
- Define typed signatures, arity and legal compositions.
- Define prerequisites/dependencies for developmental ordering.
- Define deterministic truth/evaluation semantics for finite worlds.
- Distinguish exact symbolic semantics from probabilistic/approximate operators.
- Permit later extension without reinterpreting historical examples.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Machine-readable operator registry exists.
- [ ] Every operator has a type signature and oracle semantics.

## Summary
Implement the truth/evaluation authority for generated worlds independently from the developmental teacher and surface renderers.

The oracle must answer queries from canonical world state and formal semantics, not from an LLM, memorized labels, or renderer conventions.

## Initial answer space
At minimum support:
- TRUE
- FALSE
- UNKNOWN
- CONFLICT

Additional task-specific values may be introduced only through versioned schemas.

## Requirements
- Deterministic query evaluation.
- Explicit handling of underdetermination and contradictory evidence.
- World-sensitive paired-counterfactual endpoints.
- Separate oracle modules where task families require materially different semantics.
- Metamorphic/property tests: negation, role swap, source-status changes, intervention changes, etc.
- Independent implementation check or dual-oracle comparison for critical families before confirmatory training.

## Common-mode specification failure control
A second implementation that copies the same mistaken interpretation can agree perfectly with the first. Therefore dual-oracle agreement is necessary but not sufficient evidence of semantic correctness.

For critical SYS-01 families, require at least one validation path whose specification lineage is meaningfully independent from the primary generator/oracle implementation. Suitable mechanisms include:
- independently authored executable fixtures derived from the semantic contract rather than primary implementation behavior;
- a separately implemented evaluator written from the frozen task semantics;
- metamorphic invariants specified before implementation details are inspected;
- exhaustive truth tables over small finite domains checked against hand-audited reference cases;
- where practical, a cold reviewer/operator validating boundary cases without access to expected implementation outputs.

The validation artifact must record what was independently specified versus merely independently coded.

- [ ] Oracle API consumes canonical semantic worlds/queries only.
- [ ] Teacher cannot override or supply gold labels.
- [ ] Small domains are exhaustively enumerated against reference expectations.
- [ ] Boundary cases for UNKNOWN/CONFLICT are covered explicitly.
- [ ] Oracle defects version and invalidate affected datasets/runs rather than being silently patched in place.
- [ ] Every generated label is traceable to oracle version and query/world identity.

## Summary
Create the concrete **local-first experimental ladder** that begins on the available M3 Ultra and earns every increase in model size, token/exposure budget, context length, precision complexity, and rented compute before SYS-01 or later scaling.

The existing roadmap has strong scientific controls but currently jumps from implementation readiness to a fixed small student and SYS-01. This issue owns the missing bridge: prove that the complete training/evaluation loop is numerically stable, measurable, resumable and scientifically discriminating on the actual local machine before larger runs are authorized.

## Why this exists
The program's governing economic/scientific principle is:

> **If the Bithkuil hypothesis is real, the learning curve should betray itself early.**

A large run should confirm an already visible signal, not be the first place we look for one. Local Apple-Silicon experiments therefore serve two purposes:

1. remove engineering uncertainty cheaply;
2. estimate whether treatment/control learning curves separate enough to justify the next rung.

This issue is not itself an efficacy claim and MUST NOT tune the final confirmatory plan to favorable local noise.

## Current implementation gap

The imported reference implementation does not yet use the M3 Ultra as a GPU training device:

- `requirements.txt` pins `torch==2.10.0+cpu`;
- the runner does not move the student or batches to MPS/Metal;
- the current ternary path is float emulation, not a native low-bit Apple kernel.

#64 owns the accelerated Apple-Silicon training path and parity evidence. This issue must consume that evidence before declaring the local machine qualified for meaningful learner throughput.

#65 separately qualifies SemIf/MLX as a decision-native helper for bounded mapping/curriculum decisions. That helper may improve local research throughput, but it is not student training and cannot substitute for #64.

## Phase 0: machine qualification
Record the actual M3 Ultra machine profile at runtime rather than assuming a particular SKU:
- unified-memory capacity and available headroom;
- GPU core count / Metal capability;
- macOS, Python, PyTorch/MLX/Metal backend versions;
- supported dtypes and quantization kernels;
- effective device throughput on representative forward/backward workloads;
- peak unified-memory behavior under training;
- checkpoint write/read bandwidth;
- thermal/throttling behavior for sustained runs where measurable.

Produce a machine-readable `local_machine_profile` bound to benchmark date and software environment.

## Phase 1: end-to-end micro-run
Run the smallest architecture that exercises the entire scientific path:

`latent world -> oracle -> codec -> tokenizer -> student -> loss -> checkpoint -> evaluation -> resource ledger`

The micro-run is successful only if it proves:
- treatment and control both can overfit a deliberately tiny learnable subset;
- losses decrease without numerical pathology;
- checkpoints/resume work;
- resource counters reconcile;
- semantic fixtures and SEALED boundaries remain intact;
- the same configuration is rerunnable from a fresh process.

No scientific interpretation is permitted from this rung.

## Phase 2: local learning-curve pilot
Select the **smallest practical model family after benchmarking**, not by folklore. Use at least three resource checkpoints on the same task family so slope can be estimated rather than comparing only terminal scores.

Candidate starting parameter regimes may be tiny-to-small models, but the exact sizes MUST be selected from measured M3 Ultra fit/throughput and frozen before pilot outcomes are inspected.

For each arm record:
- semantic exposures;
- nonpadding/padded tokens;
- optimizer steps;
- estimated FLOPs;
- wall time;
- peak unified memory;
- checkpoint size;
- DEV competence trajectory;
- retention probe trajectory.

Purpose: identify whether the harness has enough dynamic range to reveal a treatment/control slope difference at local cost.

## Phase 3: local replicated pilot
If Phase 2 is learnable and non-ceiling/non-floor, run a small paired-seed replication using the same frozen pilot contract.

This is still exploratory engineering evidence. It may justify SYS-01 parameterization or show that the local regime is underpowered, but it MUST NOT be retroactively promoted to the confirmatory experiment.

## Phase 4: escalation handoff
Produce a gate receipt stating one of:
- `LOCAL_READY_FOR_SYS`: engineering stable and task regime sufficiently discriminating;
- `LOCAL_REGIME_TOO_SMALL`: engineering valid but effect resolution inadequate under measured hardware budget;
- `HARNESS_NOT_READY`: unresolved engineering/integrity defects;
- `NO_EARLY_SEPARATION_OBSERVED`: both arms learn, but no useful exploratory slope separation appears within the frozen pilot budget.

The receipt must recommend the **next smallest justified rung**, not automatically rented compute.

## Compute-ratchet invariant
Every material increase in any of the following must cite the preceding rung's evidence:
- parameter count;
- exposure/token budget;
- context length;
- number of paired seeds;
- precision intervention complexity;
- external/rented accelerator spend.

Do not change several axes at once unless the next experiment explicitly studies that joint change.

## Relationship to SYS-01 and #3
- This issue is a **pre-confirmatory engineering/power ladder**.
- #3 remains the positive-result escalation policy after confirmatory evidence.
- #22 remains the frozen SYS-01 preregistration.
- Local pilot observations may inform feasible bounds before #22 is frozen, but the final confirmatory endpoints/gates MUST be locked independently of favorable pilot noise.
- A local null does not prove the Bithkuil hypothesis false; it establishes only what was or was not resolved at the measured local regime.
- #23 consumes this issue's qualification receipt; #52 does **not** depend on #23.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Actual M3 Ultra machine profile is captured automatically and versioned.
- [ ] #64 proves at least one Apple-GPU student-training path or records a measured reason to retain CPU execution.
- [ ] The selected local backend preserves #62 semantic initialization within the declared tolerance.
- [ ] A complete micro-run executes locally from latent world through analysis artifacts.
- [ ] Kill/resume is exercised on the local backend.
- [ ] At least one local learning-curve pilot measures multiple resource checkpoints per arm.
- [ ] Pilot configuration is frozen before comparing treatment/control trajectories.
- [ ] Peak memory, throughput and wall time are measured rather than guessed.
- [ ] The smallest stable/discriminating local rung is documented.
- [ ] A machine-readable escalation receipt identifies the next justified rung and rationale.
- [ ] No rented-compute run is justified merely because local results are ambiguous.

- #21 resource accounting
- #62 semantic initialization
- #64 Apple-Silicon training backend qualification

## Summary

Implement a deterministic semantic-initialization path for the Bithkuil student so "trained from scratch" means **no inherited pretrained capability**, not "all semantic coordinates begin as unrelated random noise."

The integrated Bithkuil treatment should begin with token/embedding geometry compiled from the versioned semantic substrate. IID random initialization remains a required attribution/control condition.

## Contract

The primary initializer consumes only project-owned, versioned semantic inputs:

- #7 semantic ABI and canonical AST
- #8 grammar-derived semantic-factor map
- #9 cognitive algebra
- #11 token ABI
- the bounded accepted semantic graph produced by #53 when that graph is part of the selected experimental epoch

It MUST NOT import pretrained task-capable model weights, teacher hidden states, SBERT-style embeddings, or frontier-model embedding vectors into the primary student.

A useful abstract contract is:

```text
semantic object s
  -> deterministic semantic feature map phi(s)
  -> width-matched initialization transform
  -> initial embedding/state vector e(s)
```

The exact feature basis is versioned. Candidate dimensions include semantic family, subtype, role, arity, scope behavior, polarity, modality, evidential status, null/default/unknown distinctions, prerequisite ancestry, typed graph neighborhood, sibling/exclusion relations, and algebraic/operator properties.

The initializer may support a trainable residual after initialization. Any stochastic residual must be separately configured, seeded, and reported. The reference profile should remain deterministic.

## Required initialization profiles

Implement at least these named profiles behind one stable interface:

- `semantic_aligned`: semantic factors are mapped to their intended token identities.
- `iid_random`: ordinary seeded random initialization for attribution and compatibility controls.
- `semantic_permuted`: reuse the same compiled semantic-vector multiset but assign vectors to the wrong token identities through a deterministic bijection.

Later factor-ablated or graph-only profiles may be added after the first attribution result. Do not widen the first implementation merely to populate a large ablation catalog.

## Scratch-training definition

For this program:

> **Scratch-trained means the learner inherits no task-capable pretrained neural weights. It does not require the project to discard semantic structure known before gradient step one.**

The initialization manifest must make that distinction machine-readable.

## Geometry and reproducibility

Every initialization artifact must record:

- semantic ABI/version hashes
- token ABI hash
- initializer profile and version
- feature-map schema/version
- projection/transform algorithm and seed if any
- embedding width and parameter class
- output tensor hash
- reserved/padding-token treatment
- any residual-noise policy

The same inputs must reproduce the same initialized tensors within the declared numerical tolerance.

#42 will measure the resulting pre-training neural geometry. #28 owns causal attribution among aligned, random, permuted, and factor-access controls.

## Ternary compatibility

#19 must declare whether embeddings remain full precision or are quantized in a given precision arm. A ternary-forward path must not silently erase the semantic initialization before training begins.

If a later precision path quantizes initialized embeddings, it must measure the geometry distortion and treat that as an explicit intervention.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] One deterministic semantic initializer compiles the bounded Bithkuil semantic substrate into the student embedding width.
- [ ] The initializer does not consume pretrained task-capable model weights or pretrained embedding vectors.
- [ ] `semantic_aligned`, `iid_random`, and `semantic_permuted` are selectable through one initialization contract.
- [ ] Same manifest and seed reproduce initialization within the declared tolerance.
- [ ] Manifest hashes bind semantic ABI, token ABI, feature map, transform, and output tensors.
- [ ] Reserved and padding tokens have explicit initialization rules.
- [ ] Unit tests prove that semantic permutation preserves the vector multiset while breaking token-to-semantic alignment.
- [ ] #42 can inspect the initialized geometry before any optimizer step.
- [ ] #18 can instantiate the same student architecture under each initialization profile.
- [ ] #19 cannot silently change embedding precision or initialization semantics.
- [ ] Random initialization is documented as a control, not as the definition of scratch training.

## Dependencies

#7, #8, #9, #11. Consume the bounded #53 graph snapshot when the selected experimental epoch uses it.

## Downstream

#18 student baseline, #19 ternary compatibility, #22 SYS-01 plan lock, #23 G0, #28 attribution controls, #42 geometry audit, #52 local qualification.

Parent roadmap: #5.

## Workability

`EXECUTABLE_LEAF`: one bounded outcome, deterministic semantic initialization plus the minimum control-compatible interface needed by the existing student and attribution plan.

issues.body:
## Publication posture

Public semantic/research specification.

## Parent

Parent: #9.  
Consumes COGAL-01 and coordinates with #7.

## Objective

Freeze the **smallest rigorous pre-language cognitive algebra** Bilqis should know before meaningful natural-language training.

The target is not a broad mathematics curriculum. It is the formal semantic machinery needed to represent and test concepts such as:

`is`, `is not`, conjunction, disjunction, XOR/XNOR, implication, equivalence, identity, inequality, quantification, entailment, contradiction, unknown/conflict, and proof state.

## Core developmental tranches

### T0 — semantic atoms and typing
Terms, variables, constants, predicates, relations, roles, arity, identity/equality, scope, binding and composition.

### T1 — propositional truth functions
TRUE/FALSE plus NOT, AND, OR, XOR, XNOR, implication, biconditional, NAND/NOR where retained, satisfiability, tautology, contradiction and equivalence.

Every operator must have deterministic truth-table semantics.

### T2 — predicate/relational logic
Finite-domain first-order semantics, equality/inequality, universal/existential quantification, substitution, free/bound variables, relation arity and basic categorical/syllogistic forms.

### T3 — proof/derivation state
Premise, conclusion, entailment, assumption, discharge, rule application, contradiction, countermodel, natural deduction, analytic tableaux/truth trees, and enough alternate proof-system representation to distinguish semantic consequence from one proof notation.

### T4 — non-bivalent epistemic state
Preserve at minimum:
- false;
- unknown / not determined;
- conflict / support for both sides;
- multiple live interpretations / ambiguity;
- inapplicable where required.

Do not assume one specific many-valued/paraconsistent logic globally. Each evaluator declares its semantics and designated values.

## Critical distinction

Neural ternary weights `{-1,0,+1}` are **not** truth values.

The semantic algebra may exploit structural resonance between signed/zero geometry and concepts such as supportive / absent / contrastive relations, but must never collapse:

`FALSE == -1`, `UNKNOWN == 0`, `TRUE == +1`.

UNKNOWN, CONFLICT, ambiguity and FALSE remain distinct semantic states even if a downstream learner uses ternary parameters.

## Required outputs

- versioned machine-readable operator/pasigraph registry;
- type signatures and arities;
- composition rules;
- deterministic finite evaluators;
- truth tables;
- finite-domain FOL fixtures;
- syllogistic fixtures;
- natural-deduction fixtures;
- analytic-tableau fixtures including branch closure/open countermodels;
- many-valued/unknown/conflict fixtures;
- explicit mapping into #7 semantic ABI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every T0-T4 primitive has a stable semantic identity.
- [ ] Each operator has a deterministic evaluator or an explicitly scoped non-deterministic/underspecified contract.
- [ ] Truth-functional operators reproduce their frozen truth tables exactly.
- [ ] Quantifier/equality fixtures execute over finite domains without English interpretation.
- [ ] At least one proposition can be proven/invalidated through multiple proof representations without changing its semantic identity.
- [ ] Analytic tableaux can represent branch expansion, closure and countermodel/open-branch results.
- [ ] FALSE, UNKNOWN, CONFLICT, ambiguity and inapplicability are non-colliding where used.
- [ ] Pasigraph identities remain independent of future numeric token IDs.
- [ ] No natural-language corpus is required to execute the conformance suite.

## Dependencies

#7 semantic ABI, COGAL-01.

## Downstream

#11 token ABI, #62 semantic initialization, COGAL-03, COGAL-04.

## Workability

`EXECUTABLE_LEAF`: one bounded semantic/proving kernel.

issues.body:
## Purpose / posture

**Public exploratory engineering and demonstration.** Produce the earliest genuinely trained, replayable, memorable Bilqis result, with learning from scratch on a **tiny declared semantic substrate**. This is an **alpha lane parallel to** the full pre-language freeze, M3 Ultra qualification ladder, and SYS-01. It does **not** replace #5/#52/#82/#86 or count as #22/#23/#24/#25 evidence.

The lesson from [ts-rust's recovery](https://github.com/pingdotgg/ts-rust/blob/main/docs/typechecker-reset-plan.md) is not that a structured representation has already proved the Bilqis hypothesis. It is that a faithful, explicit representation and a real behavioral oracle can make an initially overwhelming engineering problem tractable, while uncontrolled local changes can corrupt global semantic behavior. **First get one bounded end-to-end system working; then measure, generalize and add mechanisms.**

## Alpha success (make it observable)

Show an **actual scratch-trained Bilqis learner**, not a hard-coded logic engine masquerading as a neural model, responding to held-out compositional queries on small generated worlds. The smallest attractive demonstrator is:

1. A real semantic world + structured query shown to the observer, with a canonical meaning that does not depend on how it is rendered.
2. A learner prediction across **TRUE / FALSE / UNKNOWN / CONFLICT**, clearly separate from the deterministic reference-oracle answer.
3. A deliberate semantic perturbation (role reversal, changed evidence, negation, changed relationship, or one new factor composition), followed by a **new prediction**. Include at least one situation where preserving uncertainty or conflict is the correct behavior.
4. Previously unseen combinations and a small hard-negative gallery: same-looking surfaces with different meaning, different surfaces with equal meaning, wrong legal interpretation, and absence of sufficient evidence.
5. A small, honest learning-curve or before/after checkpoint display including the actual training budget and failures. A matched easy generic-typed/opaque control is useful when cheaply available; it is **not** an excuse to postpone the first demo.

The **model** must produce the predictions. Oracle traces, UI annotations and deterministic semantic explanations may be presented for interpretation but must never be labeled the model's own reasoning.

## Minimum engineering contract (alpha only)

- **Use what exists.** Start from the repository's `bilqis_ref` finite-world reference, tests, codec/oracle machinery and small student. Work through #7/#10/#11/#12/#13/#18/#19/#62's **already available subset**. No large new intermediate framework or full Rosetta/New Ithkuil parser is a prerequisite.
- **Micro-substrate.** Freeze a tiny versioned slice of T0/T1 logic, plus at least one composed relation/evidence or T2/T4 challenge. Keep identity, roles, scope, unknown/false/conflict and provenance distinctions explicit **where used**. Declare omitted families rather than pretending the full #80/#84/#86 foundation is done.
- **Learning.** No inherited task-capable pretrained neural weights or teacher embeddings. Prefer the intended **semantic_aligned** initializer and **ternary-forward** learner as the headline configuration. Use dense/reference behavior as an engineering witness when useful. Run a CPU smoke check if it gets the first gradient sooner; use the M3 Ultra accelerated path when practical, without waiting for full #64 parity certification. Do not claim native ternary-kernel acceleration from float emulation.
- **Teacher.** A fixed or simple deterministic developmental schedule is sufficient. #16's future learned teacher, #65's Kev/SemIf sidecar and #68's door-walk work are optional additions, never alpha blockers or substitutes for learned Bilqis competence.
- **Checks that are cheap but real.** Fixed compact positive/negative examples, an independent expected-output witness for key boundary cases (small hand-audited truth tables or explicitly authored vectors suffice for exploratory alpha), replayable world/query IDs, a clean TRAIN/DEV/held-out split, no answer leakage, at least one seen-primitive/unseen-composition probe, and a **do-not-lose-known-pass** smoke regression set. Record non-runnable tests as missing, not as passes.
- **Run identity.** Minimal manifest: source commit, micro-substrate+token/codec versions, oracle version, seed, architecture, initialization profile, train precision, backend/device, dataset split IDs, checkpoint hash, terminal status, model predictions/oracle results, wall time, examples/tokens/steps and available memory. Failed attempts count. Freeze a shown demo checkpoint before presenting its results.
- **No premature optimization.** Literal semantic adapters and clear types first. Test observed parity before replacing representations, caches or state machines. Do not introduce deferred/incomplete states as completed results. Record approximation and unimplemented semantics explicitly.

## Deliverables / acceptance

- [ ] One command runs a fresh-process alpha training/evaluation cycle from the small existing reference, saving a real model checkpoint and manifest.
- [ ] At least one reproducible demonstration shows **genuine held-out composition**, two semantic perturbations, and correct or transparently incorrect model predictions next to oracle answers.
- [ ] Include an UNKNOWN-versus-FALSE and a CONFLICT-versus-UNKNOWN test; include a wrong-but-plausible/negative case.
- [ ] Ternary-forward + declared semantic initialization is exercised, or a specific measured blocking defect and honest dense-first fallback are recorded. No low-bit hardware speed claim without measurement.
- [ ] Compact regression suite includes named pass/fail/missing results and catches an intentionally injected semantic/label failure.
- [ ] Results include any visible baseline, measured wall/compute/resource counters, known limitations and complete failed attempts; no cherry-picked-only success gallery.
- [ ] Demonstration surfaces clearly identify **neural predictions**, **formal oracle results**, and **human-authored explanations**.
- [ ] End in one of `ALPHA_DEMO_REPRODUCED`, `ALPHA_LEARNS_BUT_GENERALIZATION_UNPROVEN`, `ALPHA_HARNESS_BLOCKED`, or `ALPHA_LEARNING_FAILED`, with smallest next action.

## Explicit non-goals / handoff

No full grammar/lexicon, universal transpilation, comprehensive ontology, automatic primitive discovery, learned theorem prover, native low-bit optimization, formal preregistration, eight paired seeds, 2nd independent complete runtime, all SYS-01 controls, or compulsory model-guided teacher. These remain owned by their existing issues.

The micro-substrate is a **versioned exploratory fixture**, not the completed #86 pre-language manifest or official Rosetta semantic authority. Early success cannot be promoted to SYS-01 evidence without satisfying #22/#23, clean data lineage and confirmatory requirements. If it is valuable, hand the exact checkpoint, tests, observed failure classes and lightweight implementation lessons to #5/#52/#7/#61/#80/#18/#19/#62/#86. If it fails, keep the failure and tighten the next smallest hypothesis.

## Dependencies and execution order

Parent #5. Consume **implemented or fixture-local** slices of #7/#10/#11/#12/#13/#18/#19/#62, with #80 providing semantic definitions as available. Do **not** block on full completion of #8/#53/#65/#79-#86/#64/#22/#23 or on the #68 parallel program. An independent visual/demo packaging child may follow after the first model checkpoint exists.

Source context (public): [ts-rust porting contract](https://github.com/pingdotgg/ts-rust/blob/main/crates/ts_goport/PORTING.md), [reset failure analysis](https://github.com/pingdotgg/ts-rust/blob/main/docs/typechecker-reset-plan.md), [regression-accountability contract](https://github.com/pingdotgg/ts-rust/blob/main/docs/typechecker-accountability.md). These are engineering **analogies**, not empirical evidence for Bilqis's learning benefit.

### Successor demonstration owner

[#103 ALPHA-02](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/issues/103) now owns the **replayable semantic microscope** presentation and per-case evidence surface, dependent on the real trained checkpoint and fixture identities produced here. #102 remains the authority for **actual Bilqis training, minimal semantics, model predictions, held-out cases, engineering/resource receipts and alpha terminal state**. Neither issue replaces #52 local qualification or #22-#25 SYS-01 confirmation. This link is append-only to preserve the original #102 contract.

### 2026-10-11 CRITICAL SOURCE-AUDIT CORRECTION: engineering harness ≠ Bilqis semantic foundation

**Applies to this issue's “Use what exists” instruction and all Codex launch prompts derived from it.** A direct audit of current `main` found that `bilqis_ref` is a **deliberately synthetic finite-world engineering reference**, not an already implemented #7/#80/#81/#62 Bilqis semantic substrate. **Do not launch a purported substantive Bilqis alpha by merely extending or training on its existing operators/token ABI.**

Verified boundaries:

- [`bilqis_ref/semantics.py`](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/blob/main/bilqis_ref/semantics.py) declares `ABI = "bilqis-finite-world-0.1.0"` and a small, author-defined predicate set (`EQ,SIZE,SAME,CONNECTED,APL,PUR,EVID,NOT,AND,OR`) over toy entity IDs, color, intended/actual use, undirected edges and 2-bit evidence reports. This does **not** implement the intended typed T0–T4 cognitive algebra, scope/binding, quantification/proof, rich epistemic relations or full donor grammar.
- [`abi/token-abi.json`](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/blob/main/abi/token-abi.json) is a **512-slot reference token manifest with 63 non-reserved tokens and 449 `<RESERVED_*>` entries**. Neither `semantics.py` nor [`codec.py`](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/blob/main/bilqis_ref/codec.py) loads it at runtime: `codec.py` independently declares its own `TOKENS` table and synthetic serialization. Token ID allocation is **not** semantic identity, ontology, executable pasigraphy or semantic geometry.
- [`bilqis_ref/model.py`](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/blob/main/bilqis_ref/model.py) currently uses seeded `normal_(mean=0,std=0.02)` initialization, **not** a working `semantic_aligned` semantic feature-map compiler.
- [`bilqis_ref/run.py`](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/blob/main/bilqis_ref/run.py) uses IID-world `DEV` probes; its `transfer=True` check reverses entity serialization and sometimes increases query depth. These are useful regression/robustness probes, **not** sufficient evidence of withheld semantic composition/family transfer.
- [Semantic/Token ABI reference](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/blob/main/docs/reference/SEMANTIC_AND_TOKEN_ABIS.md) explicitly calls the ABI package-local; [Ithkuil primitive coverage](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/blob/main/docs/reference/ITHKUIL_PRIMITIVE_MAP.md) distinguishes implemented **subsets**, specified future semantics and deferred families.

**Corrected alpha starting gate (small, but real):**

1. Reuse `bilqis_ref` only where it already earns its keep: train/checkpoint/restart machinery, reference oracles, small-world generation patterns, negative tests, reproducible fixture infrastructure, and explicit representation controls. *Do not reuse its toy ontology or 512-token registry as normative Bilqis semantics.*
2. Before substantive alpha training, compile a **versioned, minimal semantic identity registry + typed AST + executable semantic contract** explicitly **sourced from [#80 COGAL-02](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/issues/80) (real T0/T1 logic)** and mapped through [#7](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/issues/7). Include a small, decision-relevant T2 relational/binding/quantifier case **or** T4 evidence/ambiguity contrast. Distinctions must be meaningful and independently testable, not a reskin of the old color/use tasks.
3. Compile those **semantic identities**, not English spelling or arbitrary integers, into an alpha-local token map and deterministic `semantic_aligned` initializer following the source/feature-map boundaries of [#11](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/issues/11), [#81](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/issues/81), and [#62](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/issues/62). Provide explicit semantic neighbors/inverses/arity/role geometry, hashes, and pre-step checks. Never infer semantic embedding geometry merely from the ordered entries of `token-abi.json`.
4. Author *genuinely withheld* composition patterns and hard negative/minimal pairs, with hand-audited independent truth expectations. Show scope/role perturbations, true/false/unknown/conflict distinctions, actual neural outputs, and a simple comparator if cheap. Do not call a reverse-serialization probe a compositional generalization result.
5. Retain #102's **fast exploratory budget**: one bounded train/eval cycle plus at most one diagnosed repair. This is a **provisional alpha semantic slice**, **not** the complete #86 pre-language substrate or the full SYS-01 / #22–#25 confirmation.

**Acceptance interpretation:** Passing existing reference tests demonstrates engineering readiness only. A checkpoint trained solely on the current `bilqis-finite-world-0.1.0` operators without the new declared #80/#7 semantic mappings may be a useful smoke artifact, but **must not be labeled `ALPHA_DEMO_REPRODUCED` for the intended Bilqis alpha**. Preserve it as an engineering witness and report the semantic gap/blocker. The true alpha requires observable learning over a minimal, sourced *Bilqis-native* substrate.

This is an **append-only correction**, not a rewrite or supersession of existing issue history. It restores the intended semantic requirement while preserving the cheap vertical-slice strategy.

### Canonical execution checkpoint, not a revised ontology (2026-10-11)

**[Copy-ready Codex ALPHA-01 → ALPHA-02 checkpoint](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1JIiyP2-4bJVWWHqYYt3TJmmY5FYwc2h-8n41TzIgydY/edit)** binds the two issue contracts into one sequential, continuous run. It is a **new execution/handoff artifact**, not a new issue, acceptance standard or semantic specification. It incorporates the [source-audit correction](https://github.com/Entif-AI/Bilqis/issues/102#issuecomment-6107272176) **before launch** without claiming Codex has received any earlier contradictory instructions.

Use `bilqis_ref` only as an engineering harness where applicable; implement the smallest #80/#7/#81/#62 **actual semantics → typed IDs → derived initial geometry** necessary for the exploratory alpha. Full #86 remains mandatory for the mainline program. Do not equate token-ABI placeholder rows, IID initialization or reverse-serialization transfer probes with semantic competence. #103 begins on a real #102 checkpoint; otherwise its dependent acceptance remains blocked. The checkpoint is ready for review/handoff, **not evidence of code execution or model learning**.

issues.title: ALPHA-01: Train and demonstrate the smallest striking logic-first Bilqis model

issues.body:
## Purpose

Package the **alpha trained model from #102** into a compact, reproducible demonstration that makes its successes *and* mistakes visible to a technically literate observer in under a few minutes. This is a **separate demonstration/presentation deliverable**, not a new model architecture, a substitute for the learner, or a new SYS-01 gate.

The key lesson from the [ts-rust differential oracles](https://github.com/pingdotgg/ts-rust/blob/main/scripts/goport/gate.sh) and the source-grounded Jev scientific-decision evaluation is that a correct **terminal verdict can hide a wrong intermediate semantic relation or downstream quantity**. The alpha should let observers see precisely that distinction.

## Minimum replayable story

Given one frozen alpha model checkpoint + versioned semantic micro-fixtures:

1. **Show the world and query** in a human-legible rendering beside the declared canonical semantic factors (not a claim that surface text was the learner input unless it was).
2. **Ask the actual trained model** to predict TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN/CONFLICT. Display the model output and **separately** the executable oracle's ground truth and a deterministic/human-authored explanation.
3. **Change exactly one semantic factor** and run again: role swap, evidence addition/removal, negation, scope, or relation edge. Show the changed world/semantic object, the gold consequence, and the model's response.
4. **Play a held-out composition** using familiar primitives in a combination withheld from TRAIN. Expose whether the result reflects transfer rather than a repeated exercise.
5. **Expose one failure**: plausible wrong intermediate relation that can leave a superficial final verdict looking correct, unknown mistakenly collapsed to false, or conflated conflicting evidence. Keep the bad model result visible, with precise failure classification.
6. If #68-#72's Kev/SemIf navigation is displayed alongside this, visibly distinguish **pretrained decision-native sidecar** from the **scratch-trained Bilqis learner**; do not merge their competence into one claim.

## Implementation posture

- CLI/notebook/replayable terminal trace is the **minimum shippable surface**. A single lightweight page or short screencast is welcome only if it takes little effort and adds real clarity.
- Consume the real checkpoint, tiny fixed showcase fixtures and oracle from #102; never hard-code correct model answers into the demo or secretly swap models after seeing the showcase cases.
- Every case has a frozen ID, truth/oracle expectation, model prediction, status, semantic-state delta, surface/codec identity, and checkpoint identity. If a decision-native selector participates, preserve chosen relation and downstream consequences *before* final labels.
- Include positive, negative, UNKNOWN, CONFLICT, ambiguity/abstention when represented, near-miss, held-out composition, and one deliberate semantic failure/repair case. Omitted/unsupported states remain explicit.
- Show at least one **information-matched** alternate rendering or generic typed control when available; do not pretend it is a controlled causal comparison without matching the necessary conditions.
- Resource panel can remain tiny: steps/exposures, nonpadding tokens, wall time, backend/precision, checkpoint identity, known developer/teacher effort if recorded. Unknown costs remain unknown.
- No invented causal explanations for neural outputs, no benchmark endpoint shopping, no cherry-picked-only victory montage, and no public-performance claim from exploratory alpha.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A fresh operator can replay the exact showcased cases using **the pinned real learner** and retrieve per-case predictions rather than only screenshots.
- [ ] A single-factor perturbation changes the canonical world/query as declared and preserves the unaffected fields.
- [ ] At least one held-out composition, one convincing near-miss, and one wrong or rejected semantic path are shown.
- [ ] Semantic relation correctness, downstream consequence correctness, model prediction, and terminal verdict are scored **separately** wherever the scenario supports them.
